name: PercentileNode
label: Percentile
description: Adds a column containing the N-th percentile of the specified column per group (or the whole table if no group columns are given).
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute the percentile for.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The numeric column to compute the percentile of.

fields.name: Percentile
fields.label: Percentile
fields.description: The percentile to compute (0-100). Defaults to 50 (median).

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to group by. Leave empty to use the whole table.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the result column. Defaults to '<ValueColumn>_Percentile'.
